name: verify-integrate
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the loop adopts a non-git VCS backend, or a model-backed verify/integrate policy replaces the deterministic gh-based gates, or when the Verdict / IntegrationResult / ReviewVerdict / ReconcileResult schemas reach a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: Two convergence fixes making auto-merge reliable the tick a PR is opened. CHANGE 1 (VERIFY): resolve a transient gh mergeable=UNKNOWN via a BOUNDED, injectable-runner + injectable-sleep poll (MERGEABILITY_POLL_ATTEMPTS/MERGEABILITY_POLL_INTERVAL_S) in gh_open_pr_source before deriving the verdict; a still-UNKNOWN result becomes a DEFERRED verdict (ok=False, transient reason) DISTINCT from the permanent CONFLICTING hard failure (derive_verdict now splits the non-mergeable reason). CHANGE 2 (RECONCILE): add same-issue open-PR dedup (C) — the new gh_open_pr_closing_issue_source seam sources the live open loop-PR set, groups by closing issue, and for each group with >1 open PR whose issue is still OPEN keeps the highest-numbered PR and closes the rest via the existing PR-close sink; ReconcileResult gains an additive `deduped` list and RECONCILE_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION -> 1.1.0. Trust-gated exactly like INTEGRATE.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md already carries the transient-UNKNOWN mergeability poll + RECONCILE (C) same-issue dedup sections (committed on this branch as the spec-update step 49ee5a9); this cycle implements them in src + tests + re-anchors the housekeep doc baseline.
